description:
Music video directed by Nobutaka Yoda for the song Shukufuku by YOASOBI. The song is based on the original novel "Yurikago no Hoshi" by Ichirou Ookouchi.

Note: The song featured in this music video also serves as the opening theme of the anime Mobile Suit Gundam: The Witch from Mercury. There exists two versions of this music video; the first being a Japanese version uploaded on October 2, 2022 and an English version of the song titled "The Blessing" also by YOASOBI, which was uploaded on November 8, 2022.
